overview_description.description: Backbone offers a mobile gaming controller that is cloud-gaming and remote-play compatible. It is a low-power, low-latency gaming device that works with the iPhone and does not require charging, allowing for responsive gaming anywhere. Backbone allows gamers to simply snap their phone into the Backbone One controller, launch the Backbone App, and begin playing mobile, console, or PC games from any location.

about_short_description.short_description: Backbone offers a mobile gaming controller that is cloud-gaming and remote-play compatible, allowing people to play games from anywhere.

product.name: Backbone One
product.description: A low-latency, plug-in mobile gaming controller for iPhone and Android devices. It provides physical controls for mobile games, cloud gaming, console remote play, and PC game streaming without requiring its own battery.

product.name: Backbone App
product.description: A mobile gaming hub that brings supported mobile, cloud, console remote-play, and PC-streaming games into one interface. It provides game discovery, personalized recommendations, controller integration, community features, and gameplay capture and sharing.

product.name: Backbone One - PlayStation Edition
product.description: A Backbone One controller variant designed with PlayStation-style controls and integration with the PS Remote Play app. It enables compatible iPhone and Android users to play games streamed from PS4 or PS5 consoles and other supported services.

product.name: Backbone+ Membership
product.description: A subscription membership for Backbone users that provides premium app features, member perks, free trials, and selected in-game or partner benefits.

product.name: Backbone One Carrying Case
product.description: A protective carrying case designed to store and transport Backbone One mobile gaming controllers and related accessories.

product.name: Backbone Pro Xbox 25th Anniversary Edition
product.description: A special-edition mobile gaming controller available in Iconic Blue, Bold Orange, or Crystal Clear finishes through a blind-box purchase format.
